title: record activity timeline: fold consecutive same-actor update entries on one record into one row with a count (renderer half of #25787)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect with a named landing site, reproduced through the public UI. This is the renderer half that triage split from #25787 (its first grade: "collapsing consecutive system entries is objectui's renderer half, and it gets its own card once the event carries the diff"). Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 (seat post #20966, session `session_01TFnDdepdwyDJeM2kJ4GtMy`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and domain are triage's; the seat suggests the UI lane.

**Business reason.** Teams read a record's discussion feed to follow what people said about the record. When a flow, rollup or seed updates the record repeatedly, the system's rows bury the human comments: thirteen in a row on one HotCRM campaign. Without folding, the feed is unusable on exactly the records that automation touches most (campaigns, opportunities under approval, cases under SLA monitoring).

**Reader who acts.** A UI dev for the record activity timeline renderer (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/ActivityTimeline.tsx` / `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`): one PR, S–M.

## Seen

`reach:` the public UI, measured once on HotCRM 18.1.0 with the demo seed. Campaign CPG-0001 → 讨论 (13) shows thirteen consecutive entries 「系统 · 8分钟前 · Updated Campaign …」, one per enrolled member ([56-campaign-tall.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/56-campaign-tall.png); [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md) §3.7). The producer half is in PR #25958: once it lands, each generic update entry names its changed fields (for example `Updated Campaign "CPG-0001": Number Sent, Responses, and Leads`), but the entries are still thirteen separate rows.

## Expected

- Consecutive update entries on the same record by the same actor (`actor_id`; null = system) within a short window fold into one feed row. The row shows the count and the union of the changed fields, for example 「系统更新了 Number Sent、Responses · 13 次」, and it expands to the individual entries.
- Rendering only. No event is dropped or merged at rest. Create, delete, comment and milestone rows never fold. A row that reaches the reader without its summary still counts.
- Strings go through the renderer's existing translation hook, with no hard-coded locale text.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectstack "activity timeline fold consecutive same-actor update entries into one row with a count" → 1 hit, #25787 (the producer half; this card is its split). objectui is frozen (merged into `ui/`), so it was not searched.
